_note: Short labels and what each NFHS-6 / Poshan indicator measures, for the stunting prescriptive model. Plain descriptions of the indicator only -- no claim that it causes stunting.

Births delivered in a health facility.measures: Share of births in the last five years that took place in a hospital, health centre or other health facility (NFHS-6).

Mothers who took iron-folic acid for 180.measures: Share of mothers who took iron-folic acid tablets for at least 180 days during their last pregnancy (NFHS-6).

Women with low BMI, below 18.5.measures: Share of women aged 15-49 whose body mass index is below 18.5, i.e. underweight (NFHS-6).

Children age 6–23 months receiving an ad.measures: Share of children aged 6-23 months who received a minimum acceptable diet (NFHS-6).

Children given the hepatitis B birth-dos.measures: Share of children aged 12-23 months who received the hepatitis B vaccine dose given at birth (NFHS-6).

Households using iodized salt.measures: Share of households using iodised salt (NFHS-6).

Women married before age 18, age 20–24.measures: Share of women aged 20-24 who were married before age 18 (NFHS-6).

Women using a mobile phone.measures: Share of women aged 15-49 who have a mobile phone they themselves use (NFHS-6).

Women using a bank or savings account.measures: Share of women aged 15-49 who have a bank or savings account they themselves use (NFHS-6).

Household members covered by health insu.measures: Share of households with any usual member covered under a health insurance or financing scheme (NFHS-6).

Children age 3–6 recorded as school-goin.measures: Share of children aged 3-6 recorded as attending pre-school in Poshan Tracker data, FY 2024-25.
